verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents choosing the region where it processes your audio. It also offers self-hosting, on-prem and on-device deployment, which gives full control over where data resides. The global realtime endpoint auto-routes to the nearest region by default, but region selection is a documented option. Missing for 10: explicit storage-residency guarantees (beyond processing region), an enumerated list of available regions with configuration detail, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Choose where Speechmatics processes your audio across the available regions.
Host our APIs in your environment, ensuring complete data privacy, infrastructure control
Run Speechmatics on device, on prem and in the cloud depending on your privacy needs.
